sources.title: Afghanistan
sources.publisher: Ministry for Foreign Affairs of Sweden
sources.officialityEvidence: Sweden Abroad is the Swedish Foreign Ministry's live country guidance for Swedish travellers. Its Afghanistan page records the continuing all-travel warning but does not establish a usable ordinary Swedish visitor-visa issuance route.
sources.supportingExcerpt: alla svenskar som befinner sig i Afghanistan att lämna landet

sources.title: Entry and exit regulations
sources.publisher: Ministry for Foreign Affairs of Sweden
sources.officialityEvidence: The live Swedish Foreign Ministry country page directly says Swedish citizens need a visa, but only refers them generally to destination embassies and does not give actual issuance timing.
sources.supportingExcerpt: För inresa i Centralafrikanska republiken krävs visering för svenska medborgare.

sources.title: Embassy travel information
sources.publisher: Ministry for Foreign Affairs of Sweden
sources.officialityEvidence: The Swedish Foreign Ministry's live Guinea-Bissau page says a visa is needed but provides neither ordinary Swedish eligibility for an arrival route nor an actual issuance point.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Du behöver visum för att kunna resa in i Guinea-Bissau.

sources.title: Embassy travel information
sources.publisher: Ministry for Foreign Affairs of Sweden
sources.officialityEvidence: Sweden Abroad's live entry guidance, updated 24 March 2026, directly names Sweden among residents eligible for Liberia's visa-on-arrival route.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Sedan mars 2025 finns det möjlighet till visum vid ankomst (Visa on Arrival) för personer bosatta i ett land utan en liberiansk ambassad, däribland Sverige.

sources.title: Liberia - Visa on Arrival
sources.officialityEvidence: The live lis.gov.lr service identifies the Liberia Immigration Service as the authority implementing the Alien and Nationality Law and describes airport biometric collection and sticker issuance.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Once completed, you will receive a visa sticker in your passport.

sources.title: Embassy travel information
sources.publisher: Ministry for Foreign Affairs of Sweden
sources.officialityEvidence: Sweden Abroad's live page directly maps Swedish citizens to Sierra Leone's eVisa portal or London mission, but does not settle when the visa itself is issued.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Svenska medborgare behöver visum för att resa in i Sierra Leone.

sources.title: Sierra Leone eVisa terms and FAQ
sources.officialityEvidence: The live official eVisa application's terms contain both email-delivery and airport/border-issuance wording, so the product name and application route do not alone normalize the Swedish route.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Once your visa application has been approved, you'll be issued your Visa upon arrival at the airport or border.

sources.title: Embassy travel information
sources.publisher: Ministry for Foreign Affairs of Sweden
sources.officialityEvidence: The live Swedish Iraqi guidance says a visa is required and that all travel is discouraged, while directing travellers to Iraq's embassy for current rules; it does not establish federal-Iraq versus Kurdistan issuance timing.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Med anledning av det försämrade säkerhetsläget avråder Utrikesdepartementet från alla resor till Irak.

sources.title: Embassy travel information
sources.publisher: Ministry for Foreign Affairs of Sweden
sources.officialityEvidence: The Swedish Foreign Ministry's live Iran guidance advises against all travel and reports unstable transportation, but supplies no ordinary Swedish visitor issuance result.
sources.supportingExcerpt: UD avråder från alla resor till Iran.

sources.title: Embassy travel information
sources.publisher: Ministry for Foreign Affairs of Sweden
sources.officialityEvidence: The live Swedish Foreign Ministry Niger page has an all-travel warning but no direct ordinary Swedish visitor issuance rule.
sources.supportingExcerpt: avråder Utrikesdepartementet från alla resor till Niger.

sources.title: Entry and exit regulations
sources.publisher: Ministry for Foreign Affairs of Sweden
sources.officialityEvidence: The live Swedish page says Swedish citizens need a visa and refers them to a Turkmen mission for detail, but does not establish an unconditional mission, electronic or border issuance path.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Svenska medborgare behöver visum för inresa till landet.

sources.title: Virgin Islands Laws Online: related Immigration and Passport legislation
sources.officialityEvidence: The current Government laws register identifies a 2026 Immigration and Passport Visa Exemption Order, but the accessible register record does not directly classify an ordinary Swedish passport or state issuance timing.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Immigration and Passport Visa Exemption Order, 2026

unresolved.reason: Sweden's current Afghanistan guidance maintains an all-travel warning and does not establish a usable ordinary Swedish short-visitor issuance route. No status is inferred from the fallback or unavailable/conditional services.

Sweden confirms that a visa is required for Swedish citizens, but the current page only refers travellers generally to destination embassies. It does not establish whether ordinary visitor issuance is advance, electronic or at the border.
Current Swedish guidance says a visa is needed but gives no ordinary Swedish passport issuance timing. That generic requirement neither establishes nor disproves the fallback arrival-visa label.
No current official primary source directly maps an ordinary Swedish passport to Niger's short-visitor issuance route. Sweden's all-travel warning is not a visa-status rule.

Sweden directly names the eVisa portal and London mission, but the current Sierra Leone official service separately describes electronic delivery and airport/border issuance. Without a resolved issuance point for the Swedish route, it is not normalized as eVisa or visa on arrival.

Sweden says a visa is required and advises against all travel to Iraq, but provides no actual issuance route. Federal Iraq and Kurdistan Region rules and operations are not flattened into the fallback arrival-visa status.

Sweden's current Iran guidance advises against all travel and records unstable operations, but does not directly establish ordinary Swedish short-visitor eligibility or electronic, mission or border issuance timing.

No current official primary source establishes a usable ordinary Swedish short-visitor route. DPRK recognition, sponsor, mission, border and operational conditions are not normalized from a generic visa-required fallback.

Sweden confirms that a visa is needed but refers travellers to a Turkmen mission for details. The current primary material does not establish an unconditional ordinary Swedish mission, electronic or border issuance path.

No current British Virgin Islands or Swedish primary source directly classifies an ordinary Swedish passport. The current BVI exemption-order register is not treated as a nationality schedule by omission, and UK rules are not transferred.

No current official source establishes one Palestine-wide ordinary Swedish visitor status. Israeli-controlled crossings, Palestinian Authority permits, recognition, territory-specific access and current operations are not flattened into the fallback ETA label.

Sweden Abroad names Sweden only as a country of residence without a Liberian embassy, not as a Swedish-passport nationality rule. Liberia's preapproved airport-sticker route is therefore residence-conditioned and cannot normalize every ordinary Swedish passport as visa on arrival or disprove the fallback eVisa label.
